concerns.text: The plan states that the CrafterBench subset is unverified and that the script will exit with an error (blocking FR‑001) if no verified URL is available, yet it also proceeds with a deterministic synthetic surrogate for CI verification. This creates ambiguity about whether the real study can run without a verified dataset. Clarify that the synthetic surrogate is only for CI and that the actual human‑subject study will be blocked until a verified dataset is obtained, ensuring compliance with Constitution Principle II.
